annotation.title_clean: S. 3008--C / A. 3008--C: Transportation, Economic Development and Environmental Conservation (TED) Budget Bill, 2025-2026
annotation.title_en: New York State Transportation, Economic Development and Environmental Conservation Budget Bill 2025-2026 (S. 3008-C / A. 3008-C)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: New York State Legislature (Senate and Assembly)
annotation.venue: New York State Senate / Assembly bill text
annotation.summary_en: New York's 2025-2026 transportation, economic development and environmental conservation budget bill, comprising Parts A–EEE. It mostly extends transit funding and traffic enforcement programs, and includes AI companion model rules (Part U) and algorithmic pricing disclosure (Part X). It has no robotics or physical-AI provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Part U amends General Business Law on AI companion models and creates a suicide prevention fund
Part X requires disclosure of algorithmically set prices
Part M commits $3bn state and $3bn city funding to MTA 2025-2029 capital program
Parts on speed and weigh-in-motion photo enforcement programs
Extensions of consumer refund and automatic renewal rules
